# GeoIP test fixture

`GeoIP2-Country-Test.mmdb` is vendored directly from
[`maxmind/MaxMind-DB`](https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB), `test-data/GeoIP2-Country-Test.mmdb`
(fetched 2026-08-29, `main` branch). Dual-licensed Apache-2.0 or MIT by that repository — not a git
submodule (the `maxminddb` crate's own test suite gates its fixtures behind one; this repo only
needs this one small file, not the rest of that submodule's other fixture databases).

Used by `crates/dnsqb-service/src/geoip.rs`'s unit tests (T-74). Not a real DB-IP Lite or MaxMind
GeoLite2 database — a synthetic test file with a handful of known IP→country mappings, generated
by that repo's own `write-test-data` tooling. `89.160.20.112 → SE` is the same known-good
assertion `maxminddb`'s own `reader_test.rs::test_lookup_country` makes against this exact file.

## `flat-country-test.mmdb`

A second, hand-generated synthetic fixture (T-226(б), 2026-09-12) — proves `GeoipReader::country`'s
flat-schema fallback path (`{"country_code": "XX"}`, the record shape `sapics/ip-location-db`'s
`user-country` dataset actually uses, confirmed against the real downloaded file), which
`GeoIP2-Country-Test.mmdb` above can't exercise (it's nested, `{"country":{"iso_code":"XX"}}`).

Generated with [`mmdb-writer`](https://github.com/vimt/MaxMind-DB-Writer-python) 0.2.7 (MIT
license) — a build-time tool only, never a runtime or `Cargo.toml` dependency of this project.
Two networks, reusing the same known-good IP→country pairs the fixture above and this project's
own `geoip.rs` tests already rely on (`89.160.20.0/24 → SE`, `81.2.69.128/26 → GB`), generated by:

```python
from mmdb_writer import MMDBWriter
from netaddr import IPSet

w = MMDBWriter(ip_version=6, database_type="country ipvAll", ipv4_compatible=True,
               description={"en": "flat-schema test fixture, mirroring sapics/ip-location-db user-country record shape"})
w.insert_network(IPSet(["89.160.20.0/24"]), {"country_code": "SE"})
w.insert_network(IPSet(["81.2.69.128/26"]), {"country_code": "GB"})
w.to_db_file("flat-country-test.mmdb")
```

Verified against Python's own `maxminddb` reader before vendoring: `89.160.20.112 → {"country_code":
"SE"}`, `81.2.69.160 → {"country_code": "GB"}`, `192.0.2.1 → None`, `database_type ==
"country ipvAll"`, `ip_version == 6` — matching the real `user-country.mmdb`'s confirmed metadata.
